decisions.reason: It has survived its first full year and clearly extends an already popular Demeter range, so the product’s value looks partly validated and the option is inexpensive to keep open.

As a 2024 launch its market value is still uncertain, but sliced cheese fits existing dairy capabilities and it is still worth keeping the option open for another year unless sales disappoint quickly.

This is also an early-stage 2024 line with unresolved demand, yet it appears close to the firm’s established cheese business, so the cost of waiting for clearer evidence is likely lower than abandoning it now.
